project_metadata.title: DelDOT DMV Potential Out-of-State Tag Holder Review System
project_metadata.target_users: DelDOT DMV compliance officers, casework analysts, and hackathon review judges
project_metadata.core_goal: Provide high-trust, operational decision support to prioritize and review potential out-of-state tag holder candidates with phase T0/T1 evidence diffs, classification probabilities, 0-to-1 priority indicators, and auditable decision logging.

header.style: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200 z-50
header.branding: Delaware Department of Transportation (DelDOT) DMV Casework Division
components: Navigation Tabs (Overview Dashboard, Case Queue, Case Workspace, CSV Import/Export, Audit Log)
Quick Stats Bar / Operational Status Indicator

visuals: Top out-of-state tag indicator summary (e.g., PA, MD, NJ, VA tag counts)

case_queue_table.style: Clean data-dense table with clear sticky header, sorting, pagination, search, and row highlight
filters: Priority Range Slider / Filter (High >= 0.7, Med 0.4-0.7, Low < 0.4)

case_detail_workspace.layout: 2-column layout: Left column for Candidate Profile & Priority Score Gauge + Classification Probabilities; Right column for T0 vs T1 Phase Comparison Diff & Reviewer Decision Logger

t0_t1_diff_viewer.description: Side-by-side visual diff component showing evidence changes between T0 (initial observation) and T1 (subsequent observation). Highlights updated fields (e.g. out-of-state days count, toll gantries passed, DL match status, neighborhood parking frequency, vehicle registration status)
t0_t1_diff_viewer.change_indicators: Green badge for resolved items, Amber/Red for escalating indicators, Slate for unchanged baseline

priority_gauge_card.description: Radial semi-circle gauge or high-visibility progress indicator showing 0.00 to 1.00 review priority index with clear risk band markers and probability bar breakdown

decision_logging_form.description: Form allowing compliance analyst to log official decision (Confirm Review Warranted, Mark Review Not Warranted, Flag Insufficient Evidence), input reviewer notes, select case tags, and save to local storage/CSV audit stream with timestamp and reviewer ID

disclaimer_banner.style: High-trust informational disclaimer box with scale/shield icon
disclaimer_banner.text: NON-DETERMINATIVE DECISION SUPPORT: This platform provides predictive triage assistance based on machine learning probability models and phase delta evidence. Output probabilities and priority indicators DO NOT constitute automated legal, residency, tax, fee assessment, or enforcement actions. All decisions require human reviewer validation in accordance with DelDOT DMV administrative policy.

csv_data_schema.export_format: standard CSV download with custom filename timestamping

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: subtle slate hover highlights on rows, smooth card elevation shadow-sm to shadow-md
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for tabs, buttons, and state toggles
motion_and_interactions.gauge_animation: smooth filling progress for 0 to 1 indicator score
motion_and_interactions.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, filter inputs, table cells, modal triggers, and form fields MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, highly responsive React application with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Ensure both mock dataset and user CSV upload functionality are seamlessly supported.

Implement full filtering, sorting, searching, detail drawer/view, side-by-side T0 vs T1 diff visualizer, probability bars, priority score gauges, note-taking, local storage persistence for reviewer decisions, and CSV export.
Maintain the light high-trust government aesthetic with DelDOT branding, clear badges, and non-determinative administrative legal disclaimers.
Verify all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, and export triggers have accurate data-testid attributes.
